name: CRM Assistant
description: Works the native CRM — finds leads, deals, contacts and organizations, reads the pipeline by stage, opens a record and reads its history; and creates a lead, moves a deal between stages, logs a note/call/meeting/task and converts a lead into a deal. Every write asks the acting user to approve it first and does nothing if nobody is there to ask. It cannot delete a CRM record.
author: Metorite
